title: Find your way around
summary: Go from a question to the right guide, and get back to where you left off.
benefit: Keep the instructions close while you work.
outcome: You can find a guide, jump to a section and share a direct link to it.

sections.title: Choose a guide
paragraphs: Start on the guides home page. Guides are grouped by topic, such as Working on boards or Writing & drawing. Each one shows a title, a short summary and the kind of guide: how-to, explanation or reference.
Type in Sniff out a guide to search titles, summaries and headings. Results that match the title come first. Clear the search to see every guide again.

flow.entry: Open a guide from the guides home page.

steps.action: Choose a heading under On this page.
steps.result: The guide scrolls to that section, and the address now points to that section.

steps.action: Copy the page address from your browser.
steps.result: The link opens the same guide at the same section. Nobody needs to sign in to read it.

flow.completion: The section link still works after a refresh. Your browser's Back and Forward buttons retrace your steps.
flow.correction: Choose another section, press Back, or return to all guides through the breadcrumb.

sections.title: Browse on a phone
paragraphs: On a narrow screen, choose Browse guides in the header to open the list of guides. Choose a guide to open it. Close guides, or Escape on a keyboard, closes the list and puts focus back on its button.
The guide itself scrolls like a normal page. On this page sits above the instructions on smaller screens.

sections.title: Get back to your boards

callout.title: Your boards stay private
callout.text: The guides are public. Reading them doesn't open a board or need an account.

paragraphs: Choose Open DoggyNote in the header or at the bottom of the page when you're ready to work. Your usual sign-in and board permissions apply there. From the app, Guides in your account menu brings you back here.
